title: GLM-5.3: Frontier coding with emergent cyber capabilities
titleZh: GLM-5.3：具有新兴网络能力的前沿编码
author: pella
relevanceReason: 命中 1 个 AI/科技关键词。

comments.author: leobuskin
comments.textRawHtml:
I bought $18 GLM official subscription yesterday (5.2, but new model version was already leaking on some docs), set it up with Claude Code harness... and I’ve bumped to $80 plan almost immediately. It’s the first model that agreed on a proper security research (red team scenario), executed it seamlessly, including 0-days in WP plugins, RCE, 6.8 kernel exploit adaptation, etc - while playing against another GLM agent as a defender (following HF story)!

I understand that such models can be used by malicious actors, but it’s fair to have it publicly available (and play on your side in case of emergency). This is what changes the world in a better way, I think, not the guardrails.
comments.textZhHtml:
我昨天购买了 18 美元的 GLM 官方订阅（5.2，但新模型版本已经在一些文档中泄露），用 Claude Code 工具进行设置......我几乎立即就升级到了 80 美元的计划。这是第一个就适当的安全研究达成一致的模型（红队场景），无缝执行，包括 WP 插件中的 0 天、RCE、6.8 内核漏洞利用适应等 - 同时与另一个 GLM 代理作为防御者对抗（以下 HF 故事）！

我知道此类模型可能会被恶意行为者使用，但将其公开是公平的（并在紧急情况下为您提供支持）。我认为，这才是以更好的方式改变世界的因素，而不是护栏。

children.author: takerofnaps
children.textRawHtml: At my work I have a $500 monthly AI budget. I have been using the $200 Claude subscription and most of my use is with Claude code. I think I'm going to switch to either kimi or glm and use the opencode harness. Both fable 5 and opus 5 have outright refused things like security related bug fixes and making monitoring tools. I am so happy that open models are good now
children.textZhHtml: 在我的工作中，我每月的人工智能预算为 500 美元。我一直在使用 200 美元的 Claude 订阅，并且大部分使用都是使用 Claude 代码。我想我将切换到 kimi 或 glm 并使用 opencodeharness。 《寓言 5》和《作品 5》都断然拒绝了诸如安全相关错误修复和制作监控工具之类的事情。我很高兴开放模型现在很好

children.author: leobuskin
children.textRawHtml: It’s comparable to Anthropic usage, to be honest. 2x GLM agents ate 18% of weekly usage on this mid-tier plan within ~8 hrs (non-stop work, a lot of tool calls, appx 4 compactions each), I think. I didn’t make a proper statistics snapshot, sorry.
children.textZhHtml: 老实说，它与人类的使用相当。我认为，2 个 GLM 代理在大约 8 小时内就消耗了这个中层计划每周使用量的 18%（不间断工作，大量工具调用，每个代理大约 4 次压缩）。抱歉，我没有制作适当的统计快照。

children.author: rattlesnakedave
children.textRawHtml: You should try a better harness. Try pi, or ohmypi if you want a good OOB experience
children.textZhHtml: 您应该尝试更好的安全带。如果您想要良好的 OOB 体验，请尝试 pi 或 ohmypi

children.author: weego
children.textRawHtml: what is a harness? The comments below are mixing IDE/ADE but other suggestions are purely terminal things and I don't get what their value is over just a terminal. Is a harness like a loop where it's just a vague thing that everyone nods about but everyone is nodding at something different?
children.textZhHtml: 什么是安全带？下面的评论混合了 IDE/ADE，但其他建议纯粹是终端的东西，我不明白它们在终端上的价值是什么。安全带是否像一个循环，它只是一个模糊的东西，每个人都点头，但每个人都在点头不同的东西？

children.author: gigatexal
children.textRawHtml: I’m in the Claude code harness for everything boat too. What are the alternatives?
children.textZhHtml: 我也使用 Claude 代码来管理一切。有哪些替代方案？

children.author: KronisLV
children.textRawHtml:
What the person above is suggesting:

* https://pi.dev/

* https://omp.sh/

(no personal opinions of either, links might be useful)

I think that OpenCode is nice, their CLI version is enjoyable and their desktop/web version is okay:

* https://opencode.ai/

I also quite like driving OpenCode through something like Kepler / Paseo and tools like that (with those I can still use my Anthropic Condition by Claude Code being treated similarly - as something that gets tasks dispatched to it, while the GUI I see is Kepler / Paseo).

On the desktop side, ZCode was surprisingly usable for something that came out of nowhere (I wasn't aware of it at all before trying out the GLM Coding Plan): https://zcode.z.ai/en
children.textZhHtml:
上面的人的建议是：

* https://pi.dev/

* https://omp.sh/

（没有任何个人意见，链接可能有用）

我认为 OpenCode 很好，他们的CLI 版本很有趣，他们的桌面/网络版本也很好：

* https://opencode.ai/

我也很喜欢通过 Kepler / Paseo 和类似的工具来驱动 OpenCode（我仍然可以使用 Claude Code 的 Anthropic Condition 进行类似的处理 - 作为将任务分派给它的东西，而我看到的 GUI 是 Kepler / Paseo）。

在桌面端，ZCode 令人惊讶地可以用于某些突然出现的东西（在尝试 GLM 编码计划之前我根本没有意识到它）：https://zcode.z.ai/en

children.author: vadansky
children.textRawHtml: Last time I tried some of these, none of them had the "manual mode" that CC has, where it shows you change by change as diffs and you can edit them before accepting and moving on to the next change. I like that because if it's going off pattern I can spot it early on and guide it correctly, instead of having to review the whole completed diff at the end when it's too late. I should spend the weekend checking them out again to see if they added that but I assume with everyone going full agent mode they probably didn't.
children.textZhHtml: 上次我尝试了其中一些，但它们都没有 CC 所具有的“手动模式”，它会显示您逐个更改作为差异，您可以在接受并继续下一个更改之前对其进行编辑。我喜欢这一点，因为如果它偏离了模式，我可以尽早发现它并正确引导它，而不是在为时已晚时必须在最后检查整个已完成的差异。我应该花周末再次检查一下他们是否添加了这一点，但我认为每个人都进入完全代理模式，他们可能没有添加。

children.author: eli
children.textRawHtml: The philosophy with Pi is it is minimal (but functional) out of the box and easily extensible. I'm not familiar with that feature but I would not at all be surprised if someone already coded a Pi extension that does it.
children.textZhHtml: Pi 的理念是它是最小的（但功能性的）开箱即用且易于扩展。我不熟悉这个功能，但如果有人已经编写了一个可以实现此功能的 Pi 扩展，我一点也不会感到惊讶。

children.author: 0xbadcafebee
children.textRawHtml:
Both Pi and OpenCode let you customize them. You tell the AI you want "something like claude code manual mode", and they'll modify your configs to do the same thing, or build an extension for you

(however, it's much faster to use Plan Mode to build a plan of what it will do, and then execute the plan in Build Mode. you can also have the AI make a script that will be executed deterministically)
children.textZhHtml:
Pi 和 OpenCode 都允许您自定义它们。你告诉人工智能你想要“类似克劳德代码手动模式”，他们会修改你的配置来完成同样的事情，或者为你构建一个扩展

（但是，使用计划模式构建一个它将做什么的计划，然后在构建模式中执行该计划要快得多。你还可以让人工智能制作一个将确定执行的脚本）

children.author: badcafe23423435
children.textRawHtml: No one in their right mind would install software using `curl | bash`
children.textZhHtml: 任何头脑正常的人都不会使用 `curl | bash` 安装软件

children.author: rob
children.textRawHtml:
T3 Code has been amazing. Completely free. Really impressed with the desktop app and the mobile app experience and the way it works seamlessly has me actually accomplishing tons of stuff while I'm out on mobile that I would otherwise have to wait to come home for. First time in a while I'm actually excited to use a desktop UI instead of the terminal. Blows away the official Claude Code mobile app. I can switch between my Claude and Codex monthly subscriptions in it as well. There's a TestFlight beta SwiftUI mobile version that's so much nicer than the one in the App Store. I'm running the nightly version of the desktop app.

And this is coming from someone that's not particularly a big fan of Theo. T3 Code should get more recognition; people aren't just aware of it yet.
children.textZhHtml:
T3 代码非常棒。完全免费。桌面应用程序和移动应用程序的体验以及它的无缝工作方式给我留下了深刻的印象，让我在使用移动设备时实际上完成了大量的事情，否则我必须等到回家才能完成。我一段时间以来第一次很高兴使用桌面 UI 而不是终端。震撼了克劳德代码官方移动应用程序。我也可以在 Claude 和 Codex 每月订阅之间切换。有一个 TestFlight beta SwiftUI 移动版本，比 App Store 中的版本好得多。我正在运行桌面应用程序的夜间版本。

这来自于不太喜欢 Theo 的人。 T3码应该得到更多的认可；人们还没有意识到这一点。

children.author: skybrian
children.textRawHtml:
If you like running everything in a VM and using a web browser as your UI, Shelley is very good: https://github.com/boldsoftware/shelley

It works nicely in the browsers on my tablet and phone, too.

On exe.dev you can ask it to customize itself, and it will automatically rebase your customizations when upgrading to a new release.
children.textZhHtml:
如果您喜欢在虚拟机中运行所有内容并使用 Web 浏览器作为 UI，Shelley 非常好：https://github.com/boldsoftware/shelley

它在我的平板电脑和手机上的浏览器中也能很好地工作。

在 exe.dev 上，您可以要求它进行自定义，并且在升级到新版本时它会自动重新调整您的自定义设置。发布。
